description: This file implements the ZooKeeper-based membership table for Orleans, defining the IMembershipTable interface methods such as reading, inserting, updating, and deleting silo membership entries, along with ZooKeeper interaction logic.

classes.name: ZooKeeperBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface using ZooKeeper to manage Orleans silo membership data, including methods for initializing, reading, inserting, updating, and deleting membership entries.

classes.name: ZooKeeperWatcher
classes.description: A watcher class for ZooKeeper events, primarily used for debugging and logging watcher events.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the ZooKeeper path for the deployment, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Atomically reads membership data for a specific silo from ZooKeeper.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all silo memberships from ZooKeeper.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Atomically inserts a new membership entry for a silo and updates table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Atomically updates a silo's membership entry and the table version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive status for a silo without affecting table version or other data.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a specified cluster.

methods.name: TryTransaction
methods.description: Executes a ZooKeeper transaction, handling common failure exceptions.
